organization.name: Toggl
organization.notes: Official current About states founded2006 inTallinn and no external funding, privately owned since2006. Current brand is Toggl, formerly Toggl Track; age follows company history.

pricingTiers.name: Starter
pricingTiers.notes: Lowest paid plan; $12/user monthly or $9/user/month annually, annual total9×12=$108. Free plan separate.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended designation verified on the official plan page; no plan inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Premium
pricingTiers.notes: Closest organizational/profitability tier; $24/user monthly or $16/user/month annually, annual total16×12=$192. Best value label does not establish Most popular.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Contact sales for custom configuration, integrations and roles; no numeric amount published.

moats.claim: Connected time records, project rates and team-capacity workflows can create moderate switching costs, while simple timers remain easy to substitute.

productReasons.claim: Calendar integrations plus manual and live timers let people capture time in their preferred workflow.
Labor costs, fixed-fee projects and profitability reports connect tracked hours to margins.
Timesheet approvals and project dashboards help teams validate entries and compare actual work with estimates.
